name: Ash vs Team Rocket Battle Set

releases.name: Ash vs Team Rocket Battle Set

description.text: 30-card deck battle set Ash VS Team Rocket, released on 21 April 2017 to replay the battles of the anime Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon: two ready-built 30-card decks for two players. Ash's deck has Ash's Pikachu-GX, using attacks familiar from the show, with Rowlet and the classmates' Pokémon such as Togedemaru; Team Rocket's deck has Team Rocket's Mimikyu-GX. Their artwork uses scenes from the anime, drawn for this set alone. It came with a playmat with anime art, a coin showing Rotom, damage counters and markers, two GX markers, a rule book and a player's guide.
